claims.text: Map navigation
claims.note: Tile title.

claims.text: Pan, zoom, layers, and switching between moisture and variance.
claims.note: Tile summary. The map is a Leaflet map, so pan and zoom are the map's own controls; the overlay holds the variance toggle and Layers.

claims.text: Read the pins, move the moisture bands, switch to variance, and filter what the map shows.
claims.note: Pins, band handles, the variance toggle and Layers are all in the map overlay. Pins not scanned today are drawn clear; see map-navigation/1/2.

claims.text: Map panel
claims.note: Retyped from behaviour to navigation.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/where/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: No dialog open.
claims.note: The push, settings and announcement dialogs open over the dashboard from the toolbar (:94-112); the guide starts with none open.

claims.text: A scan from the past seven days, so that the map shows pins.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim dashboard-overview/before/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Band boundaries and the variance view are saved to your own user preferences, not to the site.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour; the source settles it. Band boundaries, the variance toggle and the Layers choice are written to the signed-in user's dashboard preferences through updateDashUserPreferences (sa-map-overlay.component.ts:50-53, :101-103, :130, :143). Nothing is written to site settings.

claims.text: Pins are coloured by measured moisture
claims.note: Step title. Only pins scanned today are coloured; see map-navigation/1/2.

claims.text: Look at the pins on the map.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/1/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Each sprinkler of a station scanned in the past seven days is a pin at its own coordinates.

claims.text: Pins scanned today are filled with a band colour: 0–5, 6–19, 20–30 or above 30 percent.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/1/3, map-navigation/1/5; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: A pin scanned today is filled with the colour of the moisture band its reading falls into, and a pin last scanned on an earlier day is drawn clear.

claims.text: If a pin is clear, it was last scanned on an earlier day.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/1/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Disabled stations are hidden while Layers is set to Enabled Stations, the default.

claims.text: A disabled station has no pin while [[Layers]] is set to [[Enabled Stations]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/1/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Four bands by default: 0–5, 6–19, 20–30, and above 30 percent.

claims.text: The course, coloured by measured moisture.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: Move the band boundaries
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Drag a handle on the colour bar under the legend.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/2/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: The colour bar under the legend has draggable handles.

claims.text: When you let go, the map recolours to the new band boundary.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Move one and the map recolours when you let go — useful when your course sits mostly inside one band and everything looks the same colour.

claims.text: If nothing changes, let go of the handle.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The map recolours when you release it.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/2/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Your boundaries are saved to your own user preferences, not to the site.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/before/1, map-navigation/2/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Dragging a handle changes the boundary and saves it to your preferences.
claims.note: Saved on release to the user's dashboard preferences as saMoistureRanges.

claims.text: Switch to variance
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: Select the variance button, [[Toggle VWC or Variance View]], beside the legend.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/3/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Select the button beside the legend, [[Toggle VWC or Variance View]].

claims.text: The pins now show how far each station is from its target, in three bands.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/3/3, map-navigation/3/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Variance colours each pin by how far it sits from its own target instead of by its raw reading, which is the view you want when targets differ across the course.

claims.text: If a pin stays clear, it was not scanned today, so it has no variance.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Use variance when targets differ across the course.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/3/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Variance view: three bands, centred on target.
claims.note: Figure caption. Default bands are below -10%, -10 to 10%, and above 10% (sa-dash-map.component.ts:65-74; legend labels sa-map-overlay.component.html:20-22).

claims.text: Open Layers
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/4/1, map-navigation/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Select [[Layers]], beside the variance button.
claims.note: The Layers control follows the variance button in the overlay (:29-39). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: A box opens with two choices, [[All Stations]] and [[Enabled Stations]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If the box does not open, select [[Layers]] again.
claims.note: Selecting Layers toggles isFilterVisible (:35), so a second selection closes the box.

claims.text: Selecting anywhere else closes it.
claims.note: The Layers box carries toroClickOutside, which calls toggleLayerOverlay (:41), so selecting anywhere else closes it.

claims.text: Layers, with All Stations and Enabled Stations.
claims.note: STRINGS.LAYERS "Layers" is rendered upper-case, "LAYERS", by the uppercase pipe (sa-map-overlay.component.html:37, :42).

claims.text: Choose the stations
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/4/1; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Select [[Enabled Stations]] or [[All Stations]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/4/2, map-navigation/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: The map draws only the enabled stations, or every station.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: If a station you expect has no pin, [[Layers]] may be set to [[Enabled Stations]], the default.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/4/6, map-navigation/1/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Disabled stations are not being adjusted, so hiding them leaves only the heads your push will affect.
claims.note: A station counts as enabled on the map when its area, its hole and at least one of its sprinkler records are enabled (sa-dash-map.component.ts:351-374), the same parent rule the pending list applies (sa-dashboard.component.ts:607-678; 373-1135 rev 02 §Push Changes Functionality). A push sends only the enabled stations whose % Adj. differs from Lynx, so the filtered map shows the heads a push can affect, a superset of the ones a given push will change.

claims.text: Layers, with All Stations and Enabled Stations.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/4/4; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Map and table stay in sync
claims.note: Step title.

claims.text: In the table, select a station row.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/5/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Selecting a station in the table highlights it on the map, and selecting a pin selects the row.

claims.text: The map zooms to that station’s pin and outlines it.
claims.note: Selecting a station circle zooms the map to it and redraws its outline in white at weight 3 (sa-dash-map.component.ts:475-487). Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/5/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.
claims.previousText: Use whichever is faster to find the head you mean.

claims.text: If no pin is outlined, the station may be disabled and hidden.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/1/4, map-navigation/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Set [[Layers]] to [[All Stations]].
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claim map-navigation/4/2; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: Selecting a pin selects its row too, so use whichever is faster.
claims.note: Evidence carried over from the earlier ledger claims map-navigation/5/2, map-navigation/5/3; the sentence was reworded for the step standard.

claims.text: One selection, shown in both panels.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: You can recolour the map by moving a band handle.
claims.note: The recolour happens on release; see map-navigation/2/3.

claims.text: You can switch between moisture and variance.
Layers hides disabled stations.
claims.note: Enabled Stations hides them, and on production it is already the default (environment.toro-prod.ts:88).
